blueprintComment: CILS B1 Cittadinanza (Centro CILS, Università per Stranieri di Siena; Sillabo B1 Cittadinanza and Criteri di valutazione, read 2026-11-12): four skills scored 12 each, all must be passed, no capitalizzazione. Only Comprensione della lettura e riflessione grammaticale is modelled (real: 12 true/false items + a 6-item multiple-choice cloze, 40 minutes, texts 350-500 words). Ascolto, Produzione scritta and Produzione orale are not modelled. Per test: reading 15 (avvisi 5, mail 5, articoli e istruzioni 5) and grammar and usage 35 on the sillabo's structures (articoli e preposizioni 5, passato prossimo e imperfetto 6, presente/imperativo/condizionale 5, pronomi 5, possessivi/dimostrativi/comparativi 4, connettivi 4, lessico e registro 6). The split is Tigertest's: CILS publishes no topic weights. Futuro and congiuntivo are not in the B1 Cittadinanza sillabo and are never tested. All items original.

examFacts.answer: CILS B1 Cittadinanza is the Italian language certificate of the Centro CILS at the Università per Stranieri di Siena for people applying for Italian citizenship by marriage or residence, who must show Italian at B1 of the CEFR under article 9.1 of Law 91/1992. It tests four skills, each scored out of 12: listening (two tasks, about 30 minutes), reading comprehension and grammar (two tasks, 40 minutes), writing (one email of 80 to 120 words, 40 minutes) and speaking (about 10 minutes with an examiner). Every skill must be passed, the certificate is valid only for the citizenship application, and a failed skill cannot be carried over: the whole exam is taken again.

claudeMdBullet: - **CILS B1 Cittadinanza** (`itcils`, the Italian B1 language certificate of the Centro CILS, Università per Stranieri di Siena, that applicants for Italian citizenship by marriage or residence present under art. 9.1 L. 91/1992 (added by D.L. 113/2018, converted by L. 132/2018), Tigertest's first Italian-language exam, base language Italian, `language: "it"`, `locale: "it-IT"`, English names in `english`, `review: { it: "model" }`, `/cils-b1-cittadinanza/*`, landing `/it/cils-b1-cittadinanza-test` from `lib/landings/itcils.it.json`): `data/italy-cils-b1-questions.json` (200 original questions written in Italian on the B1 Cittadinanza sillabo: reading with an original notice, email or article in each stem, avvisi e annunci 20, mail e lettere 20, articoli e istruzioni 20; grammar and usage, articoli e preposizioni 20, passato prossimo e imperfetto 24, presente, imperativo e condizionale 20, pronomi, ci e ne 20, possessivi, dimostrativi e confronti 16, connettivi 16, lessico e registro 24), four 50-question tests (IDs 27401-27404, 5/5/5/5/6/5/5/4/4/6 per test, Tigertest's split) and five Italian-named topic sets 27401-27405 (60/36/44/36/24), 9 dashboard steps, state `ITCILS`, prefix `ITCILS-`, 60% readiness line (30 of 50, Tigertest's). The real exam (Centro CILS sillabo and criteri, read 2026-11-12) scores four skills at 12 points each, every one to pass (7 of 12 by the CILS rule for 12-point modules, not stated for B1 c by name), no capitalizzazione: Ascolto (2 tasks, about 30 minutes), Comprensione della lettura e riflessione grammaticale (12 true/false items and a 6-gap multiple-choice cloze, 40 minutes), Produzione scritta (one email, 80 to 120 words, 40 minutes), Produzione orale (about 10 minutes). Only reading and grammar are modelled; ours are four-option items. Futuro and congiuntivo are left out because the B1 Cittadinanza sillabo lists only presente, passato prossimo, imperfetto, infinito, imperativo and condizionale presente.
